subject: Re: Kickoff: MIR / wtd-Assign — closing decisions
body:
Team,

Wrapping the window (May 11). Decisions:

1) We adopt Gustavo's scoping: the design note ships with a hard recommendation of bag size <=32 for wtd-Assign, with the 2.4x MSE degradation curve as the headline chart. The two partners with 50+ person bags get an explicit "not yet" rather than a maybe.
2) The Evalline nightly benchmarks stay on as a regression suite — Emeka, please hand pager duty for those jobs to the platform rotation before you roll off.
3) For Q3 OKR planning (locked 2026-06-26): I'm proposing one OKR around onboarding the first small-bag partner dataset, not the big ones. That matches what we can actually deliver.

Emeka's v2 port plan is appended to the design note as-is. Nice clean close, everyone — this one did what it said on the tin.

Dmitri
